sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 529 Bnss No. - 1664 of 2025

Applicant :- Sushama Mishra
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 6 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Tripathi,Surya Prakash Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.

1 . This application under Section 529 Bnss has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to decide the Case No. 5308 of 2021 arising out of case crime no. 19 of 2021, under
Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 Ipc, and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Bhadohi
pending in the Court of Civil Judge (J.D.) F.T.C., Women Harrassment, Bhadohi at Gyanpur
expeditiously within stipulated period.

entities.text: D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Bhadohi
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the injured/ witness informant in the said matter, which is pending since 2021.
It is further submitted that any how the charges were framed on 13.5.2025 and now the matter is pending for evidence.
The Court concerned is not taking proper interest in disposal of the said case.

Sushama Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62745457/
1

entities.text: Sushama Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

6. The applicant before this Court is the informant of the case and since the case is fixed for evidence, normally it starts with the deposition of P.W.1/ informant, but it is surprising that instead of producing her evidence before the Court, she has knocked at the door of this Court seeking relief for expeditious disposal of the case in a time bound manner.
7.

In the circumstances, the applicant is directed to appear and cooperates with the trial Court and if she cooperates, the trial Court shall make all endevours to decide the aforesaid case expeditiously,
keeping in view the heavy work load in the said Court.

8. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 8.7.2025 Fhd
